Visual search API · Python

FastAPI service

  • OWLv2 detector: 36 garment prompts, lazy-loaded
  • FashionCLIP embedder: 512-d, L2-normalised
  • FAISS IndexFlatIP: exact cosine search
  • Per-product dedupe, thresholds, category boost
  • SSRF-guarded image fetcher for indexing
Storage

SQLite → in-memory index

  • vectors.db is the source of truth; loaded into FAISS at startup

SIGNATURE FEATURE
How “search by photo” works
1

Upload

The shopper picks or takes a photo. WordPress checks the real image type, caps the size and keeps it privately for 30 min.

2

Detect

OWLv2 runs 36 descriptive prompts (a pair of heels) and keeps the best box per garment type → tappable chips.

3

Crop

The chosen box is cropped with 10% padding: a little context (hem, collar) improves matches.

4

Embed

FashionCLIP turns the crop into a 512-d vector, L2-normalised so inner product = cosine similarity.

5

Search

FAISS returns top_k × 6 image neighbours → best image per product → score threshold.

6

Rank

Products whose category matches the item (“Dress”, فستان) move first; hidden products are dropped.

⚡ /v1/search/quick skips detection and searches the whole photo
🧩 The same index powers “similar items” on product pages
